products.name: Flux Encoder
products.description: Queue, inspect and encode media with hardware-aware FFmpeg profiles.

entries: Synchronized package and suite metadata for the v0.8.18 alpha development release.
Uses the suite-owned rendering interfaces when receiving Flux Motion export jobs.

products.name: Flux Motion
products.description: Design broadcast graphics, titles and motion scenes in one focused workspace.

entries: Added native Chart layers with seven chart types, Static or external data, per-value colors, shared gradients and optional OBS-dock exposure.
Improved playback and adaptive-resolution performance while keeping OBS, final output and cache rendering at full quality.

Added the in-window Welcome popup with Flux Motion branding and application logo, plus the standalone New Title format dialog; enabled first-install precaching and fixed initial text, canvas layout and strict Play after rendering behavior.

products.name: Flux Motion Plugin for OBS
products.description: Cue and render Flux Motion projects directly inside OBS Studio.

entries: Added shared native Chart rendering with consistent external-source settings, field mappings, colors, gradients and selected Static Data values exposed in the OBS dock.
Kept OBS-created titles on the active OBS resolution and frame rate, and made cached chart animation deterministic.
Fixed first-frame Text rendering with caching and simplified Playback and Cache controls to Clear All Cache and Cache Entire Timeline.
